exact_report_text: EPAM has emerged from acquisition-driven reported growth into modest organic growth and better margins. However, part of the earnings improvement comes from lower bonus expense, and cash conversion has not improved comparably. At $159.31, the stock is about 28% above the $124 central FCFF scenario and offers only about 15% upside to a substantially stronger $183 favorable case. A $84 adverse case remains plausible if AI productivity reduces billable work or customer spending stalls. Retain for monitoring; no attractive central-case margin of safety is demonstrated. Do not treat a repurchase announcement as executed or as free value creation.

Mantener en observación, sin entrada aprobada. La recompra anunciada no se considera ejecutada ni crea valor gratuitamente.
